title: Sliders and number fields with a scale to read
blurb: Five more controls from the ui-feed collection, rebuilt around native elements: ranges as the faders of a mixing desk and the tuning slide of a hi-fi tuner, number fields as the plates on a barbell and the drop of a pair of curtains, and radios as the objectives of a microscope.
question: Can a native range sit under a handle that the canvas moves (a fader cap, a tuning slide with a flywheel), and can a number field or a radio group drive a drawing that has to be read as a measurement?
result: Yes in the test browser. The range under each handle is placed with a draw with no alpha and the control reads the pointer itself. One element submits three values through ElementInternals. Nothing here is verified on a phone.
